skill.name: chrome-extension-icons
skill.description: Generate Chrome extension icon PNGs from Iconify or local SVG files, then update manifest.json icon entries.
skill.summary: Generate Chrome extension icon assets and update manifest icon entries.
skill.author: Boulea7

security_audit.summary: I found no malicious prompt injection or stealth behavior in the audited files. The static findings are false positives caused by documented command examples, JavaScript template literals, expected Iconify network use, expected manifest file operations, and a DEBUG flag. The skill still performs user-visible network and filesystem actions that should remain clearly disclosed.

remediation.issue: External Iconify requests are required for search and download.
remediation.suggestion: Keep network use explicit in the marketplace listing and ask before sending search terms to Iconify.

remediation.issue: User-selected paths can overwrite manifest and icon files.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize paths, warn before overwriting existing files, and keep writes inside the active project when possible.

remediation.issue: Dependency troubleshooting includes privileged package installation guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Present sudo commands as manual user steps and never run privileged installation without explicit confirmation.

content.value_statement: Chrome extension icons need specific sizes and manifest entries. This skill searches Iconify, converts SVGs to PNGs, and updates manifest.json.
actual_capabilities: Searches Iconify for extension icon candidates by keyword.
Downloads selected Iconify SVG icons for conversion.
Converts SVG input into 16, 32, 48, and 128 pixel PNG files.
Updates manifest.json icon entries and action default icons when present.
Converts local SVG files into Chrome extension icon assets.
Runs batch generation from a project configuration file.
limitations: Requires Node.js and the Sharp image library to run successfully.
Uses the Iconify network API for search and remote icon downloads.
Color changes work best with simple single-color SVG icons.
Chosen output and manifest paths can overwrite existing project files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a new extension icon set
use_cases.description: Generate all required Chrome extension icon sizes and add them to a new manifest.

use_cases.title: Convert a product logo
use_cases.description: Turn a local SVG logo into transparent PNG assets for browser extension distribution.

use_cases.title: Refresh several extension projects
use_cases.description: Use a batch configuration to create icon assets for multiple related extensions.

prompt_templates.title: Create basic icons
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new icon set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate Chrome extension icons for a calendar extension. Use a clean icon and update my manifest.json.

prompt_templates.title: Use a brand color
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a home icon for my Chrome extension and generate the required PNG sizes in color #2563eb.

prompt_templates.title: Convert my SVG logo
prompt_templates.scenario: User already has a logo file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert my local logo.svg file into Chrome extension icon sizes and connect them to manifest.json.

prompt_templates.title: Batch several projects
prompt_templates.prompt: Create icons for three Chrome extension projects using a batch configuration, then summarize which projects succeeded.

output_examples.input: Generate a calendar icon for my extension.
output_examples.output: Found a matching calendar icon, generated four PNG sizes, and updated the extension manifest with the new icon paths.

output: Converted the local SVG into Chrome extension PNG assets.
Updated the manifest so Chrome can use the generated assets.

output_examples.input: I do not like the first music icon.
output_examples.output: Presented alternative music icons with preview links so the user can choose another style before generation.

best_practices: Preview the selected icon before generating files.
Confirm output paths before replacing existing extension assets.
Review manifest changes after generation finishes.
anti_patterns: Generating icons without confirming the intended style or keyword.
Running batch generation without checking each project path.
Using complex multicolor SVG files when exact color replacement is required.

faq.question: What icon sizes does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates 16, 32, 48, and 128 pixel PNG files for Chrome extension manifests.

faq.question: Can it use my own SVG file?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert a local SVG file into the required PNG icon sizes.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Internet access is required when searching Iconify or downloading an Iconify SVG icon.

faq.question: Will it edit manifest.json?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create or update manifest icon fields using the generated file paths.

faq.question: Can it apply brand colors?
faq.answer: Yes. Color replacement is supported, but it works best on simple single-color SVG icons.

faq.question: Can it process several extensions at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The batch command reads a configuration file and processes multiple projects in sequence.
